decisions.reason: Changing the NFT standard to ERC-721C does not alter the IPFS provider, hosting role, or removability of the stored ebook copy.
The token-standard decision does not change the optional offline download link or its email presentation.
ERC-721C ownership verification does not change the read-only default, PDF.js technology, or reader entry points.
The candidate already has a complete message-241 MODIFY recording ERC-721C, OpenSea Creator Controls, and marketplace whitelisting for royalty enforcement.
The token-standard change does not alter any current metadata identity, badge, ticket-counter, referral-code, or gated-viewer attribute.
The current About-page copy does not specify ERC-721 versus ERC-721C and remains valid unchanged.
The FAQ state does not specify the NFT token standard, and its royalty, ownership-transfer, and ebook-access explanations remain valid.
Selecting ERC-721C for creator controls does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
The no-referral commission amount and random-holder allocation remain unchanged by the token-standard decision.
The no-referral ticket recipient-selection rule is independent of the ERC-721C marketplace-control decision.
Marketplace whitelisting and royalty enforcement do not change which book access, referral number, badges, or ticket state transfers to a secondary buyer.
The ERC-721C decision does not alter Chainlink VRF, winner eligibility, probability weighting, on-chain selection, or verification.
